n = int(input().strip())
line = input()

import re

regex = r"\([\w_]*\)"
segments = re.split(regex, line)

max_word_length = 0
for segment in segments:
    current_max = max([len(s) for s in segment.split('_')] + [0])
    if current_max > max_word_length:
        max_word_length = current_max

pattern = re.compile(regex)
matches = pattern.findall(line)

total_inside_words = 0
for match in matches:
    inside = match[1:-1]  # remove parentheses
    total_inside_words += len([s for s in inside.split('_') if s])

print(f"{max_word_length} {total_inside_words}")
